facts.text: Ontario's College of Physicians and Surgeons approved rules: safer supply only with opioid agonist therapy, taken in front of a health-care professional
The college dropped a previously considered eight-week safer supply prescribing limit
Metrolinx shutting Lakeshore West between Aldershot and Oakville Oct. 17-18; no service at Appleby or Bronte
TPS charged Syed Raza, 29, with arson and related offences over Israeli flags burned in front of a church Oct. 7
Raza was scheduled to appear at the Toronto Regional Bail Centre Oct. 11
Canada Pulse Insights poll for CityNews: 35% of Torontonians don't feel safe walking their neighbourhood after dark
CP24/Nanos poll shows Bradford narrowing Chow's lead (Chow 51, Bradford 47 among decided voters)
City of Toronto: 222,550 advance votes over six days ending Oct. 11, up from 129,745 in the 2023 by-election
More than 50 candidates running; polls suggest a tight Chow-Bradford race
Florin Mitea, 34, and Gabriel Mitea charged over fatal Oct. 11 Scarborough crash
A 68-year-old woman in the Ford Escape died after the Oct. 11 crash at Lawrence Ave. E. and Scarborough Golf Club Rd.
Gabriel Mitea's age is disputed: TPS says 25, CBC says 24
Police say a man claiming to be a 'Spiritual Holistic Healer' sexually assaulted a person near Eglinton Ave. E. and Yonge St. on Oct. 9
Eglinton suspect described as 50-60, medium build, long black and grey hair in a black dew rag, full beard
CP24 reports 225,550 advance voters (conflicts with city's 222,550), with a 53,363 single-day record Oct. 11
Election day is Monday, Oct. 26, polls open 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.
No implementation date for the safer supply changes is stated
Not established whether Raza's Oct. 11 bail centre appearance happened
Paul Conn, 71, charged with five counts of sexual assault, three of sexual interference and four of sexual exploitation
Police allege Conn met the victim while working at a church near Bloor West and Kipling and assaulted the youth repeatedly 2021-2026
Conn was scheduled to appear at Toronto Regional Bail Centre Oct. 13 at 9:30 a.m.

Chow called advance numbers a confidence signal; Bradford said they show 'change is coming'
